rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute top of its daily range (97.8%) after a massive 16.3% gap-up, indicating extreme short-term exhaustion and high risk of a mean-reversion pullback. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity to the high and the significant distance to support (VWAP at $222.50), while shorting a strong momentum breakout immediately after an earnings beat is counter-trend and prone to being stopped out by continued buying pressure.
